2608.07086.title: Beyond Isolation: Unlocking Reinforcement Learning Component Synergy for Sample-Efficient Continuous Control
2608.07086.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning systems are significantly more complex than other machine learning paradigms due to inherent properties, causing RL system design to jointly account for many tightly coupled factors. Despite advances in individual algorithmic components, their functional interdependencies remain underexplored: do they exhibit mutual synergy or counterproductive interference? To bridge this gap, we conduct a systematic investigation and find that the efficacy of different components exhibits significant task-dependency, and naively stacking state-of-the-art techniques does not necessarily yield performance gains; instead, it often triggers emergent challenges, such as compounded non-stationarity. Building upon these findings, we distill a suite of actionable insights into the principled coordination of these components. Guided by these insights, we propose ROSER, an RL framework that coordinates three critical dimensions: Model-based Representation, Optimization Stability, and Experience Replay. Across diverse continuous-control benchmarks, ROSER consistently outperforms vanilla baselines and achieves 17.60% gains over naive stack. Our findings underscore the necessity of a holistic perspective in RL system design and paves the way for developing sample-efficient agents.
2608.07086.paper_summary_zh: 增強學習系統因其固有特性而比其他機器學習範式複雜得多，這使得增強學習系統的設計必須共同考量許多緊密耦合的因素。儘管在個別算法組件上取得了進展，但它們的功能相互依賴性仍然未被充分探索：它們是否展現出相互協同或是產生反效果的干擾？為了填補這一空白，我們進行了系統性的調查，發現不同組件的效能顯著依賴於任務，而天真的堆疊最先進的技術不一定會帶來性能提升；相反，它往往會引發新出現的挑戰，例如複合的非平穩性。基於這些發現，我們提煉出一套可操作的見解，以原則性地協調這些組件。在這些見解的指導下，我們提出了 ROSER，一個協調三個關鍵維度的增強學習框架：基於模型的表示、優化穩定性和經驗重放。在各種連續控制基準測試中，ROSER 始終超越普通基準，並在天真堆疊上實現了 17.60% 的增益。我們的發現強調了在增強學習系統設計中採取整體觀點的必要性，並為開發樣本高效的代理鋪平了道路。
